meta.name_zh: 癌症登記檔長表 LF(2007-2010年)
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 各醫院自 2007 年起新診斷的癌症個案應全部改採新版癌症登記項目申報。其中 50 床
以上的醫院依短表摘錄手冊規定申報癌症發生和診療摘要資料；另原參與 TCDB 申報
的醫院，則依長表摘錄手冊申報六大癌症(子宮頸癌、乳癌、口腔癌、肺癌、肝癌、結
直腸癌)之發生和診療詳細資料。
2. 自2008診斷年新增攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌，共十大癌症。
3. 自2009診斷年新增鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共十五大癌
症。
4. AJCC 癌症分期版本於診斷年 2007-2009 年採用第六版申報，自診斷年 2010年起個案，
均採用第七版申報。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 自 2007 年起，癌症登記長表申報均採用 95 欄位；且適用於所有診斷年 2002 至 2010
年個案，故癌症登記長表 95欄位資料庫包含部分 2002至2006 診斷年之個案。
2. 長表醫院所需申報之癌症類型除 2007 年申報的子宮頸癌、乳癌、結直腸癌、口腔癌、
肺癌、肝癌，及 2008 年新增的攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌外，2009年再增加鼻
咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共 15種癌症。
3. AJCC 癌症分期第六版與第七版之間，因部分癌別其 TNM 與期別組合 Stage 在兩個版
本之間有不同，故分析不同診斷年之間的期別分布時，應小心詮釋。
4. 首次復發資料收錄為個案經診斷為癌症後，追蹤滿五年內是否首次發生癌症復發狀態，
僅個案分類 1 與 2 者須追蹤申報該欄位內容。若五年內首次復發後，仍再重複復發，
本欄位僅記錄第一次復發狀態；若超過五年後才發生首次復發，則本欄位登錄為無復
發。有關復發資訊僅於診斷後滿一年與滿五年各申報一次。
5. 死亡日期、死亡原因等欄位，因受限於醫院申報癌登資料之時程，此二欄位較不完整，
若需完整資料，建議申請死因統計檔使用。
6. 本使用手冊係依據臺灣癌症登記中心手冊，詳細內容請至臺灣癌症登記中心網頁下載，
如「96年版台灣癌症登記摘錄手冊」。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分證字號、
院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等欄位均經屏蔽處
理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審核通過之統計結果，以
確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。 1. 身分證字號(ID)經加密處理。
2. 個人歸戶及個人資料對照的鍵值：ID。

meta.data_description_en: 1. From 2007, all newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital must be reported using the new cancer-registry items. Hospitals with 50+ beds report cancer incidence and treatment summary data per the short-form manual; hospitals formerly participating in TCDB report detailed incidence and treatment data for six major cancers (cervical, breast, oral, lung, liver, colorectal) per the long-form manual. 2. From diagnosis year 2008, prostate, stomach, esophagus, and bladder were added (10 major cancers). 3. From 2009, nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers were added (15 major cancers). 4. AJCC staging used the 6th edition for diagnosis years 2007-2009 and the 7th edition from 2010.
meta.notes_en:
1. Starting in 2007, cancer registry long-form reporting has used the 95-field format, which applies to all cases diagnosed between 2002 and 2010; therefore the 95-field cancer registry long-form database includes some cases diagnosed between 2002 and 2006.
2. In addition to the cervical, breast, colorectal, oral, lung, and liver cancers reported in 2007, and the prostate, gastric, esophageal, and bladder cancers added in 2008, long-form hospitals were required to report nasopharyngeal cancer, major salivary gland cancer, corpus uteri cancer, ovarian cancer, and hematologic malignancies starting in 2009, for a total of 15 cancer types.
3. Because the combination of TNM and Stage differs between AJCC 6th and 7th edition staging for some cancer types, care should be taken when interpreting stage distributions across different diagnosis years.
4. First-recurrence data records whether a case experienced its first cancer recurrence within five years of follow-up after the cancer diagnosis; only cases classified as 1 or 2 are required to have this field tracked and reported. If, after a first recurrence within five years, further recurrences occur, this field records only the first recurrence status; if the first recurrence occurs more than five years after diagnosis, this field is recorded as no recurrence. Recurrence information is reported only twice: once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.
5. Because hospital reporting of cancer registry data is time-constrained, the date-of-death and cause-of-death fields are relatively incomplete; if complete data is needed, it is recommended to apply for the Cause of Death Statistics File instead.
6. This user manual is based on the Taiwan Cancer Registry Center's manual; for details, please download from the Taiwan Cancer Registry Center website, e.g., the "2007 (ROC year 96) Taiwan Cancer Registry Abstracting Manual."
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.
1. The ID number (ID) is encrypted.
2. The key for linking records to an individual and matching individual data: ID.

meta.data_description_en:
1. Starting in 2007, all newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital were required to switch entirely to the new cancer registry reporting items. Hospitals with 50 or more beds report cancer incidence and treatment summary data according to the short-form abstracting manual; hospitals that previously participated in TCDB reporting report detailed incidence and treatment data for the six major cancers (cervical, breast, oral, lung, liver, and colorectal cancer) according to the long-form abstracting manual.
2. Starting with diagnosis year 2008, prostate cancer, gastric cancer, esophageal cancer, and bladder cancer were added, bringing the total to ten major cancers.
3. Starting with diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal cancer, major salivary gland cancer, corpus uteri cancer, ovarian cancer, and hematologic malignancies were added, bringing the total to fifteen major cancers.
4. Cases diagnosed in 2007-2009 were reported using AJCC 6th edition staging; cases diagnosed from 2010 onward have all been reported using AJCC 7th edition staging.
meta.notes_en: 1. To meet clinical cancer-care needs, from ROC 98 (2009) the HPA began planning to add site-specific-factor data to the Taiwan Cancer Registry long-form database; for public-health reasons, smoking, betel-nut chewing, alcohol use, height, and weight were added and revised in the ROC-100 (2011) abstracting manual. 2. Beyond the cancers reported in 2007 (cervical, breast, colorectal, oral, lung, liver) and added in 2008 (prostate, stomach, esophagus, bladder), 2009 added nasopharyngeal, major salivary gland, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic cancers; 2010 expanded to the top 10 cancers in men and women (oral, colorectal, liver, lung, breast, cervical, esophagus, stomach, prostate, bladder, major salivary gland, nasopharyngeal, uterine corpus, ovarian, and hematologic tumors). From 2013, laryngeal cancer was added, and some hospitals reported the all-cancer long form from diagnosis year 2013. 3. Eligible cases are ROC nationals (foreigners excluded) first diagnosed with cancer by a physician. 4. In principle each cancer case is reported once, but another primary site (i.e. multiple primary cancer) requires an additional report. 5. Cancer cases newly diagnosed on or after 1 January 2011 are reported per the ROC-100 abstracting manual. 6. First-recurrence data records whether a first cancer recurrence occurs within five years of follow-up after diagnosis; only case classes 1 and 2 must report this field. If recurrence repeats after a first recurrence within five years, only the first recurrence status is recorded; if a first recurrence occurs after five years, the field is recorded as no recurrence. Recurrence data is reported once at one year and once at five years after diagnosis.

meta.name_zh: 癌症登記檔長表 LF(2011-2017年)
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 各醫院自 2007 年起新診斷的癌症個案應全部改採新版癌症登記項目申報。其中
50 床以上的醫院依短表摘錄手冊規定申報癌症發生和診療摘要資料；另原參與
TCDB申報的醫院，則依長表摘錄手冊申報六大癌症(子宮頸癌、乳癌、口腔癌、
肺癌、肝癌、結直腸癌)之發生和診療詳細資料。
2. 自2008診斷年起新增攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌，共十大癌症。
3. 自2009診斷年起新增鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，共
十五大癌症。
4. 自2013診斷年起新增喉癌，共十六大癌症。
5. AJCC 癌症分期版本於診斷年 2010 年起個案，均採用第七版申報。
meta.notes_zh:
1. 為因應癌症診療實務之需求，國民健康署於民國 98年起，開始著手規劃於台灣
癌症登記長表資料庫中增收癌症部位特定因子之資料；同時基於公共衛生的考
量，並將吸菸、嚼檳榔、飲酒、身體及體重之收錄納入 100 年版癌症登記摘錄
手冊中增修。
2. 長表醫院所需申報之癌症類型除 2007 年申報的子宮頸癌、乳癌、結直腸癌、口
腔癌、肺癌、肝癌，及 2008年新增的攝護腺癌、胃癌、食道癌和膀胱癌外，
2009年再增加鼻咽癌、主唾液腺癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌和血液腫瘤，2010年擴
大至男、女前 10癌(口腔癌、結直腸癌、肝癌、肺癌、乳癌、子宮頸癌、食道
癌、胃癌、攝護腺癌、膀胱癌、主唾液腺癌、鼻咽癌、子宮體癌、卵巢癌及血
液腫瘤等)。
自2013年起再新增喉癌，且部分醫院於 2013診斷年起申報全癌長表。
3. 收案對象為中華民國國籍(外籍人士不收案)，第一次經醫師診斷為癌症之個案。
4. 原則上每一癌症個案申報一次，但有另一個原發部位(即多發癌症 multiple
primary cancer)需再申報。
5. 2011年1月 1日以後新診斷之癌症個案，依 100年版台灣癌症登記摘錄手冊申
報。
6. 首次復發資料收錄為個案經診斷為癌症後，追蹤滿五年內是否首次發生癌症復
發狀態，僅個案分類 1與2者須追蹤申報該欄位內容。若五年內首次復發後，
仍再重複復發，本欄位僅記錄第一次復發狀態；若超過五年後才發生首次復
發，則本欄位登錄為無復發。有關復發資訊僅於診斷後滿一年與滿五年各申報
一次。

meta.name_zh_from_listing: Health14_癌症登記檔長表LF(2018年以後版本)
meta.data_description_en:
1. Starting in 2018, newly diagnosed cancer cases at each hospital have been reported using the 2018 (ROC year 107) version of the cancer registry items. Hospitals with 50 or more beds report cancer incidence and treatment summary data according to the short-form abstracting manual; hospitals that also participate in long-form reporting report important cancer care data such as the stage, detailed treatment, and recurrence of major cancers according to the long-form abstracting manual. (A small amount of data includes supplementary reports for cases diagnosed before 2017.)
2. Starting with diagnosis year 2002, the long-form TCDB first collected data on cervical cancer, breast cancer, oral cancer, colorectal cancer, liver cancer, and lung cancer.
3. Starting with diagnosis year 2008, prostate cancer, gastric cancer, esophageal cancer, and bladder cancer were added, bringing the total to ten major cancers.
4. Starting with diagnosis year 2009, nasopharyngeal cancer, major salivary gland cancer, corpus uteri cancer, ovarian cancer, and hematologic malignancies were added, bringing the total to fifteen major cancers.
5. Starting with diagnosis year 2013, laryngeal cancer was added, bringing the total to sixteen major cancers.
6. Starting with diagnosis year 2022, pancreatic cancer was added, bringing the total to seventeen major cancers.
7. Three versions of AJCC cancer staging are used within the long-form database:
Cases diagnosed with cancer between 2003 and 2009 are staged according to AJCC 6th edition.
Cases diagnosed with cancer between 2010 and 2017 are staged according to AJCC 7th edition.
Cases diagnosed with cancer from 2018 onward are staged according to AJCC 8th edition.
Cervical cancer cases diagnosed from 2021 onward are staged according to AJCC 9th edition.
Starting from AJCC 9th edition, stage information is updated for each cancer type as needed.
8. For guidance on analyzing long-form data, refer to the Taiwan Cancer Registry Center website: https://twcr.tw/?p=3284.
9. To analyze detailed information such as radiotherapy equipment or dose, be sure to consult the Taiwan Cancer Registry Long Form Abstracting Manual and pay attention to the relationships among the various radiotherapy fields.
meta.notes_en: Records the case's betel-nut chewing before the initial diagnosis date. Digits 1-2 are daily quids chewed: 00: None; 10: 10/day; 20: 20/day; 90: >=90/day; 91: Occasional; 98: Chews, amount unknown; 99: Not recorded/unknown. Digits 3-4 are years chewed: 00: None; 05: 5 years; 15: 15 years; 98: Chews, years unknown; 99: Not recorded/unknown. Digits 5-6 are years since quitting: 00: Not quit; 05: Quit 5 years; 15: Quit 15 years; 88: Never chewed; 98: Quit, years unknown; 99: Not recorded/unknown.
